scope: standalone Ship Runtime composition-owned frame clock and input boot prerequisites

target.entry_interrupt_state: SEI from the verified cold-stager trampoline
target.ship_backing: private Runtime BSS counter advanced by a chained raster IRQ owner
target.irq_chain: Ship counts and acknowledges its raster source, then chains the inherited KERNAL vector so GETIN service remains owned
target.independent_progress_oracle: full 9-bit $D011/$D012 high-to-low transition, never $D012 alone or the counter under test
target.enable_readback: $D01A bit 0 and $0314/$0315 handler identity before CLI
target.publication_order: RUNTIME_LOADED follows successful arm and repeated-progress verification
target.input_acceptance: physical interactive Ship sample; no synthetic target claim

host.oracle_owner: host witness supplies complete 9-bit raster samples and a separate IRQ pulse; Ship recognizes the boundary
negative_executions: one incidental wrap then silence must fail
host.positive_execution: one synchronization wrap plus three unit deltas

gate_rule: a gate must not model the code assumption or a simplified register assumption as its oracle; clock gates execute the real 312-line 9-bit sequence, bind an independent IRQ pulse, and require repeated progress
release_gate: one physical Ada+RETURN interaction after Link 88
